hero.title: Salt Exporter from India Global Supply
hero.intro: Vacuum evaporated, FSSAI and FSSC 22000 certified salt, manufactured by one of the leading bulk salt exporters in Gujarat's marine salt belt, supplied to international buyers with the certifications and port access that global trade demands.

globalMarkets.heading: Global Markets We Serve
globalMarkets.subheading: Our export network, grouped by region and updated as new markets come online.

certifications.heading: Export Certifications
certifications.subheading: The compliance documentation international buyers ask for first: not a logo wall, the real standards behind it.

items.name: FSSAI
items.issuer: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
items.description: Our FSSAI license means we are registered, inspected and authorised to manufacture and export food grade salt from India.

items.name: Halal Certified
items.description: Confirms our manufacturing process meets Islamic dietary requirements, verified by an accredited certifying body. It's a requirement for many of our Middle East and Africa buyers.

items.name: FSSC 22000
items.description: As FSSC 22000 certified salt manufacturers, we hold one of the most widely recognised food safety certifications globally, accepted by retailers and food businesses across every market we ship to.

items.name: ISO 9001:2015
items.description: Confirms our processes, from sourcing to packaging, are consistently managed and audited to an international quality standard, not checked just once.

logistics.heading: Port & Logistics Advantage
logistics.subheading: Built on India's busiest export corridor: not a courier route, direct access from plant to port.

ports.name: Kandla Port
ports.description: One of India's largest cargo ports by volume, sitting minutes from our manufacturing plants on National Highway 8A. Built for high volume bulk export.

ports.name: Mundra Port
ports.description: As rock salt suppliers using Mundra Port, India's largest private port and container terminal, we get direct access to major global shipping lines for containerised export.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: What international buyers ask us most before placing an order.

items.question: Does Ankur export salt from India to other countries?
items.answer: Yes. Ankur is a trusted salt exporter from India, currently supplying to 17 countries across 4 regions worldwide.

items.question: What certifications does Ankur's exported salt have?
items.answer: Ankur is FSSC 22000 certified salt manufacturers, and also holds FSSAI, Halal, and ISO 9001:2015 certifications, meeting international food safety standards.

items.question: Which ports does Ankur use for export shipments?
items.answer: Ankur uses Kandla Port and Mundra Port in Gujarat, both offering direct access to major global shipping lines for bulk and containerised export.

items.question: Does Ankur supply edible salt for export?
items.answer: Yes. Ankur is one of India's edible salt export suppliers, offering food grade salt that meets international quality and safety requirements.

items.question: How can I request an export quote?
items.answer: You can share your requirement through the export enquiry form on this page. Our export team will follow up with a quote and expected lead time.
